title: BPW-2026-0592
text:
[BUREAU OF STREET SERVICES]
BPW-2026-0592
ADVISEMENT #1
CD 3
TREE REMOVAL – 19910 - 20018 WEST LORNE STREET AND 8120 NORTH QUAKERTOWN AVENUE
Recommending the Board:
DETERMINE that the sidewalk repair project at 19910 West Lorne Street, 19911 West Lorne Street, 19923 West Lorne Street, 19926 West Lorne Street, 19927 West Lorne Street, 19930 West Lorne Street, 19931 West Lorne Street, 19936 West Lorne Street, 19960 West Lorne Street, 20007 West Lorne Street, 20012 West Lorne Street, 20018 West Lorne Street and 8120 North Quakertown Avenue is within the scope of the Sidewalk Repair Program (SRP) as described in the SRP Environmental Impact Report (EIR) under the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), approved in 2021 and 2026, and that the 2021 and 2026 SRPEIR adequately describe the project for purposes of CEQA;
APPROVE the project as a Non-Qualifying Sidewalk Repair Program Project pursuant to LAMC 62.104.1(b)(3), including
CONCUR with the Bureau of Engineering’s (BOE’s) approval of the Project;
APPROVE the removal of thirteen Tulip (Liriodendron tulipifera) trees for the reconstruction of an inaccessible sidewalk and tree replacements; and
DIRECT the BOE that a notice of determination be filed with the State Office of Planning and Research and the Los Angeles County Clerk.
(CONTINUED FROM MONDAY, NOVEMBER 16, 2026)
